# Artificer

## Overview
# Class Overview

The Artificer is a master inventor, engineer, researcher, and creator who blends magic, science, craftsmanship, and innovation into a single discipline. Unlike traditional spellcasters who channel magic through faith, instinct, or study alone, Artificers view magic as a resource to be understood, refined, and engineered.

Where a Wizard studies spells, an Artificer studies systems.

Through experimentation and invention, Artificers create gadgets, constructs, enchanted equipment, dimensional technologies, alchemical compounds, and soul-powered creations capable of reshaping the world around them. Their workshops produce wonders that many consider impossible, while their inventions often blur the line between magic and technology.

Artificers are natural problem-solvers. Every challenge presents an opportunity for innovation. Every obstacle is simply a puzzle waiting to be solved.

Whether constructing mechanical companions, crafting legendary artifacts, manipulating matter itself through Arcane Exchange, or carrying entire buildings in their pockets, Artificers are defined by one principle:

> If it does not exist, build it.

## Class Identity

The Artificer excels through preparation, creativity, and invention rather than direct magical power.

### Primary Roles

- Crafter
- Inventor
- Enchanter
- Researcher
- Support Specialist
- Resource Manager
- Utility Expert

### Secondary Roles

- Construct Commander
- Battlefield Controller
- Alchemist
- Engineer
- Explorer

## Artificer Motto

> "Magic is not a mystery. It is a system waiting to be understood."

## Talent Tree
Talent pathways live in the talent folders for this class. Each talent has its own page under `talents/tier-*`.

## Lore
# Origins of the Artificers

Long before the modern age, magic was viewed as a force to be worshipped, feared, or studied. Few considered building with it.

The earliest Artificers were craftsmen, miners, alchemists, blacksmiths, and scholars who became frustrated by the limitations of conventional magic. While Wizards debated theory and Clerics sought divine guidance, these pioneers sought practical solutions.

They asked questions others ignored: why cast the same spell every day when a device could perform the task indefinitely, why rely on magical talent alone when power could be stored, and why learn a spell when a machine could replicate its effect?

## The First Innovators

The first true Artificers appeared during the Age of Discovery. These individuals began combining smithing, enchanting, alchemy, runecraft, engineering, and arcane theory into a new field of study.

The earliest inventions were simple: self-heating cookware, enchanted lanterns, automated pumps, and reinforced tools. Over time these creations became more ambitious, eventually producing devices capable of rivaling spellcasters.

## The Great Debate

The rise of the Artificers sparked controversy across Asteria. Traditional scholars argued that magic should be studied. Artificers argued that magic should be used. Traditional enchanters argued that magic is sacred. Artificers argued that magic is a resource.

## The Age of Invention

As Artifice spread throughout the world, entire industries emerged around Artificer creations: arcane lighting systems, mana-powered tools, mechanical transports, automated workshops, and dimensional storage devices.

Many cities owe their growth to inventions developed by Artificers. Some kingdoms owe their survival to them. Others blame them for countless disasters. Both are often correct.

## The Soul Revolution

The greatest breakthrough in Artificer history came with the discovery of Soul Integration. Researchers discovered that soul energy could be captured, refined, and utilized within crafted objects.

This led to the creation of Soul-Bound Items, Arcane Reactors, Scaling Creations, Living Constructs, and Sentient Artifacts. The discovery revolutionized the profession, and also created some of its greatest dangers.

## The Philosophy of Creation

Artificers do not view creation as a finished act. Nothing is truly complete. Everything can be improved. Every invention may be refined. Every design may evolve. Every problem has a solution.

## Artificers and Society

Artificers may become master craftsmen, guild engineers, royal inventors, researchers, explorers, merchants, treasure hunters, relic seekers, dungeon delvers, monster researchers, or independent inventors.

Many travel the world searching for lost schematics, ancient technologies, rare materials, and forgotten knowledge. To an Artificer, every ruin is a library, every artifact is a lesson, and every mystery is an opportunity.

## The Artificer Creed

> We build.
>
> We improve.
>
> We discover.
>
> We create.
>
> We fail.
>
> We learn.
>
> We build again.

## Legacy

The greatest Artificers are remembered for what they leave behind: a bridge that still stands, a reactor that still burns, a construct that still walks, a fortress that still protects, or an invention that changed the world.

# Antimony Ingot

## Overview
Antimony Ingot is an uncommon processed material used for specialised alloy work, alchemical vessels, and crafting projects that need hard but brittle reinforcement.

## Appearance
An Antimony Ingot appears as a dark silver-purple bar with a glassy metallic sheen, sharp edge highlights, and fine fractured patterns across its surface.

## Source & Processing
Antimony Ingots are made by smelting Antimony Ore under controlled conditions, then casting the refined material into standard bars for trade or workshop use.

## Crafting Grade
Antimony Ingot is a specialised grade material. It is useful for hardening and stabilising, but careless use can make finished work brittle.

## Uses
Antimony Ingots are used in alloy hardening, reinforced tool edges, ritual fixtures, alchemical vessels, and experimental smithing.

## Alchemy Uses
Shavings or powder from Antimony Ingots can be used in binding salts, purging reagents, and stabilising compounds.

## Crafting Uses
Antimony Ingots are best used as a secondary metal in alloys rather than as a primary weapon or armor base.

## Culinary Uses
Antimony Ingot has no culinary use and should not be handled as food-safe material.

## Magical Affinities
Antimony holds faint Earth and Shadow affinities, making it useful where a darker or stabilising mineral resonance is required.

## Market Value
Antimony Ingots are moderately valuable and usually traded through smithing guilds, alchemists, and mining settlements with specialist furnaces.

## Related Items

- Alchemy Tools

# Antimony Ore

## Overview
Antimony Ore is an uncommon mineral resource used by smiths and alchemists for hardening alloys, stabilising volatile mixtures, and producing specialised metalwork.

## Appearance
Antimony Ore forms dark metallic crystal clusters with purple-blue highlights and sharp fractured faces. Rich samples can look almost glassy under lamplight.

## Deposit & Habitat
Antimony Ore is usually found in narrow mineral veins, deep mine pockets, old volcanic seams, and shadow-touched stone layers.

## Mining
Miners extract Antimony Ore carefully because brittle crystals can fracture during rough handling. Good samples are sorted away from waste stone before smelting.

## Refinement
Antimony Ore is smelted into Antimony Ingots or blended into harder alloy batches. Poor ventilation can make processing hazardous.

## Uses
Antimony Ore is valued for alloy work, alchemical powders, stabilising compounds, and specialised crafting where brittle hardness is useful.

## Crafting Uses
Antimony Ore refines into Antimony Ingots and can be used in alloy hardening, tool reinforcement, and controlled experimental smithing.

## Alchemy Uses
Powdered Antimony Ore may be used in purging reagents, binding salts, and stabilising preparations that need a sharp mineral anchor.

## Magical Affinities
Antimony carries faint Earth and Shadow affinities. It is usually quiet but can hold darker resonance better than common iron.

## Market Value
Antimony Ore has moderate value and is most available near specialised mining settlements or alchemical trade routes.

# Iron Ingot

## Overview
Iron Ingot is a common processed metal material used throughout Asteria for basic smithing, structural fittings, weapons, armor, tools, and settlement repairs.

## Appearance
An Iron Ingot is a dark silver-grey bar with a dull metallic finish, forge scale along its edges, and occasional blackened hammer marks or casting seams.

## Source & Processing
Iron Ingots are usually made by smelting Iron Ore in a forge or bloomery, removing impurities, and casting the workable metal into standardized bars.

## Crafting Grade
Iron Ingot is a basic grade material. It is reliable, widely available, and easy for most trained smiths to shape, but it lacks the superior edge retention or arcane receptivity of rarer metals.

## Uses
Iron Ingots are used for practical construction, reinforcement, common tools, chains, nails, hinges, buckles, cookware, and the internal fittings of many crafted objects.

## Alchemy Uses
Powdered or shaved iron may be used in grounding compounds, warding circles, magnetic experiments, and low-grade Earth-aspected preparations.

## Crafting Uses
Iron Ingots are core inputs for basic weapons, basic armor, shields, traps, tool heads, wagon fittings, door hardware, and forge repairs.

## Culinary Uses
Iron Ingot has no culinary use.

## Magical Affinities
Iron carries a faint Earth affinity. It is stable, grounding, and resistant to volatile magical resonance, making it useful in mundane equipment and simple warded fixtures.

## Market Value
Iron Ingots are inexpensive near mines and smithing towns, but their value rises in remote settlements, war camps, and regions with poor access to metal deposits.

# Iron Ore

## Overview
Iron Ore is a common mineral resource used as the foundation for basic smithing, tools, fittings, structures, and low-tier martial equipment.

## Appearance
Iron Ore appears as dark grey, reddish-brown, or black stone with metallic flecks and rust-coloured staining. Freshly broken pieces may show a dull metallic shimmer beneath rough outer rock.

## Deposit & Habitat
Iron Ore is usually found in hills, mountain seams, exposed cliff faces, and established mines. It may also appear in old battlefield earth, collapsed tunnels, and riverbeds below eroded ore-rich slopes.

## Mining
Miners extract Iron Ore with picks, wedges, and basic mining tools. The ore is common enough that most mining settlements know how to identify and sort usable pieces from waste stone.

## Refinement
Iron Ore is smelted in a forge or bloomery. A standard working ratio is four units of ore for one Iron Ingot, though local purity and forge quality can improve or reduce the final yield.

## Uses
Iron Ore is primarily valuable because it becomes Iron Ingots. It can also be used as ballast, crude pigment, construction fill, or a low-grade trade resource in mining regions.

## Crafting Uses
Iron Ore refines into Iron Ingots for basic weapons, armor, tools, hinges, nails, bindings, chains, and structural fittings.

## Alchemy Uses
Iron Ore has limited alchemical use on its own. Powdered ore may be used in grounding compounds, magnetic experiments, or earth-aspected reagent tests.

## Magical Affinities
Iron Ore carries a faint Earth affinity. In most cases its magical profile is stable and quiet, making it useful as a mundane base material rather than a high-power arcane reagent.

## Market Value
Iron Ore has low market value but high practical demand. It is inexpensive near mines and more valuable in isolated settlements without local metal deposits.

# Rose

## Overview
Roses are common flowering plants found in tended gardens, old courtyards, hedgerows, and temperate plains near settled roads. In Asteria, they are valued as a simple fragrant ingredient and a low-grade life-aspected reagent.

## Appearance
A rose grows as a thorned green stem with layered petals ranging from pale blush to deep crimson. Healthy plants carry a clean floral scent, glossy leaves, and sharp hooked thorns that can catch cloth or skin.

## Habitat
Roses prefer temperate soil, steady sunlight, and places where water does not stagnate. They grow naturally in plains and hedges, but the finest blooms are usually cultivated in gardens, temple grounds, estates, and healer courtyards.

## Harvesting
Flowers are clipped just below the bloom to preserve the petals and oil. Thorns make careless gathering uncomfortable, but the plant is otherwise easy to harvest. Spring and summer blooms are most abundant, with small yields possible in sheltered gardens.

## Uses
Rose petals are used for perfume, ceremonial offerings, scented oils, poultices, and basic trade bundles. Dried petals are easy to transport and are often sold by herbalists and village markets.

## Alchemy Uses
Rose petals can soften the scent of harsh brews and serve as a minor stabilizer in gentle restorative mixtures. They are too weak for major healing on their own, but they are useful in early potion practice.

## Crafting Uses
Roses can be processed into perfume, pressed dyes, incense blends, decorative garlands, and minor healing potion additives. Thorns may be used as small natural pins or ritual markers.

## Culinary Uses
Petals may be candied, steeped into mild tea, or used sparingly in sweet syrups where the plant has been grown away from toxins or grave soil.

## Magical Affinities
Roses carry a faint Life affinity linked to renewal, beauty, memory, and gentle restoration. Certain regional variants may develop stronger affinities when grown near shrines, leyline gardens, or enchanted groves.

## Market Value
Roses are low-value and widely available in settled regions. Fresh blooms are cheapest near gardens and towns, while preserved petals and oils carry slightly higher value for crafters and alchemists.

## Related Items
- Minor Healing Potions
- Perfume
- Garden Biomes
- Herbalist Profession

- Playable: Yes
- Rarity: Very Rare

- Height Range:
  - Male: 5'10" - 6'5" (155cm to 198cm)
  - Female: 5'6" - 6'1" (170cm to 185cm)

# Air Pixie

## Overview
# Pixie Lore

Pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **Avalon’s will and magic**. They are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

Though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## Origins of the Pixie

Pixies first emerged during the **Early Bloom of Avalon**, when the Fae Realm stabilised after its initial formation. Unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

Pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
They were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

From their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

Each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **Sprite**. Together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## The Split Soul Doctrine

Pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- Pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- Sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

Ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. A whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. A split soul remains adaptable.

This belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## The Worldroot Gate (Tree Portal)

Pixies do not freely cross between realms.

Instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **Worldroot Gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **Avalon** and **Asteria**.

### Key Facts
- The gate opens **once every 50 years**
- It remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- Only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- Mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

To pixies, this event is known as **The Crossing Bloom**.

---

## The Crossing Bloom

The Crossing Bloom is a time of:
- Celebration
- Mourning
- Oaths
- Long journeys

Pixies born in Avalon may choose to:
- Visit Asteria
- Remain behind permanently
- Escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- Observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

Pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

Those who miss the Crossing Bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## Pixies in Asterian History

Pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

They prefer to act as:
- Whispered guides
- Unseen helpers
- Saboteurs of great evils
- Inspirers of invention and art

Many pivotal moments in Asterian history coincide with **Crossing Bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## Notable Pixie Figures

### ✦ Queen Lythiriel of the Shimmergrove
The only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

Lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the Worldroot Gate was damaged by planar instability. Her reign lasted only one Crossing Bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into Avalon’s upper canopies.

Pixies still swear rare oaths **“by Lythiriel’s Leaves.”**

---

### ✦ King Bramblethorn (The Unwilling King)
A title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

Bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the Worldroot Gate during a Crossing Bloom. Though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across Asteria.

Some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

A pixie hero bound to fire.

Nyx is credited with:
- Diverting a volcanic eruption
- Burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- Teaching early fire-mages restraint

Nyx never returned to Avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

Pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ The Glimmerhands
A collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- Ever-burning lanterns
- Floating instruments
- Soul-safe crystal foci

Each item crafted by a Glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

An eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

Thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by Asterian artificers today. Many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

Pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

They admire:
- Creativity
- Defiance
- Emotional depth

They fear:
- Obsession
- Exploitation of magic
- Attempts to control the Worldroot Gate

Pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

In the current age, pixies believe:
- The realms are drifting further apart
- Crossing Blooms feel more dangerous
- Magic in Asteria is becoming volatile

- Remain forever in Avalon  
- Or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

# Pixie Lore

Pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **Avalon’s will and magic**. They are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

Though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## Origins of the Pixie

Pixies first emerged during the **Early Bloom of Avalon**, when the Fae Realm stabilised after its initial formation. Unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

Pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
They were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

From their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

Each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **Sprite**. Together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## The Split Soul Doctrine

Pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- Pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- Sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

Ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. A whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. A split soul remains adaptable.

This belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

Pixies do not freely cross between realms.

Instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **Worldroot Gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **Avalon** and **Asteria**.

- The gate opens **once every 50 years**
- It remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- Only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- Mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

To pixies, this event is known as **The Crossing Bloom**.

The Crossing Bloom is a time of:
- Celebration
- Mourning
- Oaths
- Long journeys

Pixies born in Avalon may choose to:
- Visit Asteria
- Remain behind permanently
- Escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- Observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

Pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

Those who miss the Crossing Bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

They prefer to act as:

# Cavern Sprite

## Overview
**Race Name:** Cavern Sprite  
**Race Category:** Small Races
**Race Type:** Sprite  
**Size:** Small
**Average Height:** 85–130 cm
**Average Weight:** 18–55 kg  
**Lifespan:** 180–260 years  
**Home Region:** Deep Caverns, Crystal Hollows, Fungal Depths, Underground Ruins  
**Primary Language:** Sprite Speak 
**Secondary Languages:** Common, Undercommon
**Rarity:** Rare  
**Alignment Tendencies:** Neutral Good, True Neutral, Chaotic Neutral

# Cavern Sprite — Short Summary Paragraph

> Cavern Sprites are small subterranean Feykin who dwell deep beneath the world within crystal caverns, fungal forests, and forgotten underground ruins. Known for their gray-toned skin, sharp elven features, and silent movements, they are masters of stealth, resonance, and survival within the endless dark. Curious yet cautious, Cavern Sprites preserve the balance of underground ecosystems and rarely trust surface dwellers.

# Official Cavern Sprite Motto

> **“Stone, Shadow, Silence.”**

![[Pasted image 20260525214029.png]]

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - 50 cm to 100 cm  

- Weight Range:
  - 10 kg to 25 kg  

- Skin:
  - Thin, smooth skin adapted to low light  
  - Colour Range:
    - Pale grey → charcoal → deep black  

- Hair:
  - Fine and soft, often uneven or naturally layered  
  - Colour Range:
    - Brown → ash → pale blonde  

- Eyes:
  - Large, slanted, highly sensitive to light  
  - Colour Range:
    - Grey → dark brown → near-black  
  - Reflect light faintly in darkness  

- Hands:
  - Small, nimble fingers  
  - Excellent grip for climbing and navigating tight spaces  

- Face:
  - Narrow features with sharp cheekbones  
  - Expressions subtle and difficult to read  

- Ears:
  - Small with slight pointed tips  
  - Highly sensitive to sound vibrations  

- Markings:
  - Faint dark patches or mineral-like streaks in skin  
  - Some may have subtle glowing veins in deep darkness  

- Body:
  - Small, lightweight build  
  - Movement is quick, quiet, and precise  

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristic Tier Cap |
| -------------- | ----------- | ---------- | :---------------------: |
| Strength       | -4          | 3d6        |         Tier 2          |
| Dexterity      | +1          | 4d6        |         Tier 5          |
| Agility        | +2          | 4d6        |         Tier 5          |
| Constitution   | -1          | 3d6        |         Tier 3          |
| Endurance      | 0           | 3d6        |         Tier 4          |
| Intelligence   | 0           | 4d6        |         Tier 4          |
| Wisdom         | +1          | 4d6        |         Tier 5          |
| Charisma       | 0           | 4d6        |         Tier 5          |
| Luck           | 0           | 3d6        |         Tier 5          |

---

## Racial Traits
### Racial Bond – Split Soul
Sprite are born with **half a soul**.

- The other half manifests as a **Pixie**
- Pixie and Sprite can sense one another across great distances
- When within close proximity, magic flows more smoothly

If the bond is damaged or severed, the Pixie and/or Sprite becomes **Unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences.

### Dark Vision
- Can see clearly in darkness up to 30m  
- No penalties in low-light environments  

### Light Footing
- Ignore movement penalties in:
  - Loose stone  
  - Uneven cave terrain  
- Reduced noise when moving over rock/stone

### Cavern Adaptation
- Advantage on checks related to:
  - Navigating caves  
  - Detecting structural instability  
  - Finding hidden paths  

### Shadow Affinity
- Increased effectiveness when:
  - In darkness  
  - Out of direct light  

### Imbued Strike (Adapted)
- Can infuse attacks or actions with dark/earth energy  
- Adds minor magical effect (scales later with system)

---

- Small size allows movement through tight spaces  
- Can climb rocky surfaces with reduced difficulty  
- Gains stealth advantage in darkness  

---

### ⚠️ Drawbacks
- Very low physical strength  
- Fragile compared to larger races  
- Sensitive to bright light (possible disadvantage in strong light)

# Dark Pixie

## Overview
# Pixie Lore

Pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **Avalon’s will and magic**. They are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

Though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## Origins of the Pixie

Pixies first emerged during the **Early Bloom of Avalon**, when the Fae Realm stabilised after its initial formation. Unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

Pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
They were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

From their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

Each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **Sprite**. Together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## The Split Soul Doctrine

Pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- Pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- Sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

Ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. A whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. A split soul remains adaptable.

This belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## The Worldroot Gate (Tree Portal)

Pixies do not freely cross between realms.

Instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **Worldroot Gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **Avalon** and **Asteria**.

### Key Facts
- The gate opens **once every 50 years**
- It remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- Only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- Mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

To pixies, this event is known as **The Crossing Bloom**.

---

## The Crossing Bloom

The Crossing Bloom is a time of:
- Celebration
- Mourning
- Oaths
- Long journeys

Pixies born in Avalon may choose to:
- Visit Asteria
- Remain behind permanently
- Escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- Observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

Pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

Those who miss the Crossing Bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## Pixies in Asterian History

Pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

They prefer to act as:
- Whispered guides
- Unseen helpers
- Saboteurs of great evils
- Inspirers of invention and art

Many pivotal moments in Asterian history coincide with **Crossing Bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## Notable Pixie Figures

### ✦ Queen Lythiriel of the Shimmergrove
The only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

Lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the Worldroot Gate was damaged by planar instability. Her reign lasted only one Crossing Bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into Avalon’s upper canopies.

Pixies still swear rare oaths **“by Lythiriel’s Leaves.”**

---

### ✦ King Bramblethorn (The Unwilling King)
A title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

Bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the Worldroot Gate during a Crossing Bloom. Though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across Asteria.

Some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ Nyx-of-the-Falling-Ash
A pixie hero bound to fire.

Nyx is credited with:
- Diverting a volcanic eruption
- Burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- Teaching early fire-mages restraint

Nyx never returned to Avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## Pixie Artisans & Crafters

Pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ The Glimmerhands
A collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- Ever-burning lanterns
- Floating instruments
- Soul-safe crystal foci

Each item crafted by a Glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ Thistlewick the Binder
An eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

Thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by Asterian artificers today. Many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## Pixies & Mortals

Pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

They admire:
- Creativity
- Defiance
- Emotional depth

They fear:
- Obsession
- Exploitation of magic
- Attempts to control the Worldroot Gate

Pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## Modern Pixie Beliefs

In the current age, pixies believe:
- The realms are drifting further apart
- Crossing Blooms feel more dangerous
- Magic in Asteria is becoming volatile

Some whisper that the Worldroot Gate may **one day fail entirely**.

If that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- Remain forever in Avalon  
- Or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## Final Words of Pixie Lore

> *“We are not small because we are weak.  We are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — Old Pixie Proverb

## 🧠 Notes

- Native to **Avalon (Fae Realm)**  
- Do not form structured societies  

Common habitats:
- Elemental groves  
- Floating crystal formations  
- Hidden fae sanctuaries  

Values:
- Freedom  
- Expression  
- Balance with nature  
- Soul connection

- Height Range:
  - 15 cm to 60 cm  

- Weight Range:
  - 2 kg to 6 kg  

- Wings:
  - Insect-like, semi-translucent magical wings  
  - Shape varies depending on elemental affinity  

- Skin:
  - Soft, glowing, slightly translucent  
  - Colour Range:
    - Pastel → vibrant → elemental hues  

- Hair:
  - Light, flowing as if weightless  
  - Colour Range:
    - White → silver → elemental tones  

- Eyes:
  - Bright and glowing with elemental energy  
  - Colour Range:
    - Matches elemental affinity  

- Hands:
  - Tiny, delicate fingers  
  - Highly precise control for fine manipulation  

- Face:
  - Soft, expressive features  
  - Emotions often visible through subtle glow changes  

- Ears:
  - Small and pointed  

- Markings:
  - Faint glowing patterns tied to elemental nature  

- Body:
  - Extremely lightweight  
  - Movements are erratic, fluttering, and quick

## Racial Traits
### Magical Affinity (Innate)
- Born with **100 Affinity** in one elemental type  
- Cannot be changed or reduced  
- Reduced backlash from aligned magic  

### Racial Bond – Split Soul
Pixies are born with **half a soul**.

- The other half manifests as a **Sprite**
- Pixie and Sprite can sense one another across great distances
- When within close proximity, magic flows more smoothly

If the bond is damaged or severed, the Pixie and/or Sprite becomes **Unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences.

### Elemental Embodiment
- Emotions influence environment slightly  
- Enhances nearby aligned magic  
- Discomfort when exposed to opposing elements  

### Fae Perception
- Detect:
  - Illusions  
  - Glamours  
  - Magical distortions  
- Strong intuition for hidden intent  
- Struggles with rigid systems or logic

## Lore
# Pixie Lore

Pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **Avalon’s will and magic**. They are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

Though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## Origins of the Pixie

Pixies first emerged during the **Early Bloom of Avalon**, when the Fae Realm stabilised after its initial formation. Unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

Pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
They were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

From their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

Each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **Sprite**. Together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## The Split Soul Doctrine

Pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- Pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- Sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

Ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. A whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. A split soul remains adaptable.

This belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## The Worldroot Gate (Tree Portal)

Pixies do not freely cross between realms.

Instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **Worldroot Gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **Avalon** and **Asteria**.

### Key Facts
- The gate opens **once every 50 years**
- It remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- Only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- Mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

To pixies, this event is known as **The Crossing Bloom**.

---

## The Crossing Bloom

The Crossing Bloom is a time of:
- Celebration
- Mourning
- Oaths
- Long journeys

Pixies born in Avalon may choose to:
- Visit Asteria
- Remain behind permanently
- Escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- Observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

Pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

Those who miss the Crossing Bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## Pixies in Asterian History

Pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

They prefer to act as:
- Whispered guides
- Unseen helpers
- Saboteurs of great evils
- Inspirers of invention and art

Many pivotal moments in Asterian history coincide with **Crossing Bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## Notable Pixie Figures

### ✦ Queen Lythiriel of the Shimmergrove
The only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

Lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the Worldroot Gate was damaged by planar instability. Her reign lasted only one Crossing Bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into Avalon’s upper canopies.

Pixies still swear rare oaths **“by Lythiriel’s Leaves.”**

---

### ✦ King Bramblethorn (The Unwilling King)
A title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

Bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the Worldroot Gate during a Crossing Bloom. Though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across Asteria.

Some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ Nyx-of-the-Falling-Ash
A pixie hero bound to fire.

Nyx is credited with:
- Diverting a volcanic eruption
- Burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- Teaching early fire-mages restraint

Nyx never returned to Avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## Pixie Artisans & Crafters

Pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ The Glimmerhands
A collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- Ever-burning lanterns
- Floating instruments
- Soul-safe crystal foci

Each item crafted by a Glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ Thistlewick the Binder
An eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

Thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by Asterian artificers today. Many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## Pixies & Mortals

Pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

They admire:
- Creativity
- Defiance
- Emotional depth

They fear:
- Obsession
- Exploitation of magic
- Attempts to control the Worldroot Gate

Pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## Modern Pixie Beliefs

In the current age, pixies believe:
- The realms are drifting further apart
- Crossing Blooms feel more dangerous
- Magic in Asteria is becoming volatile

Some whisper that the Worldroot Gate may **one day fail entirely**.

If that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- Remain forever in Avalon  
- Or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## Final Words of Pixie Lore

> *“We are not small because we are weak.  We are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — Old Pixie Proverb

# Drownedborn Undien

## Overview
- Race Category: Demi-Race
- Race Type: Spiritborn Humanoid
- Parent Race: Drowned Spirit × Humanoid
- Playable: Yes
- Rarity: Rare

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - Male: 5'10" - 6'5" (155cm to 198cm)
  - Female: 5'6" - 6'1" (170cm to 185cm)

- Weight Range:
  - 55 kg to 90 kg 

- Skin:
  - Smooth skin with an almost translucent appearance
  - Often cool and slightly damp to the touch
  - Colour Range:
    - Pale Blue
    - Seafoam Grey
    - Silver White
    - Mist Grey
    - Deep Ocean Blue

- Hair:
  - Constantly appears wet regardless of environment
  - Moves subtly as if suspended underwater
  - Colour Range:
    - Black
    - Dark Blue
    - Silver
    - White
    - Sea Green

- Eyes:
  - Deep reflective eyes that resemble still water
  - Colour Range:
    - Silver
    - Pale Blue
    - White
    - Sea Green
    - Moonlit Grey

- Hands:
  - Long fingers with slightly elongated joints  
  - Slight webbing between digits
  - Slightly colder to the touch

- Face:
  - Soft angular features
  - Ethereal appearance
  - Calm, distant expressions

- Ears:
  - Slightly elongated
  - Finned edges common among older bloodlines

- Markings:
  - Natural glowing tide-like markings
  - Resemble flowing currents and waves
  - Intensify during spellcasting

- Body:
  - Lean and graceful build
  - Fluid movements
  - Naturally buoyant in water

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristics Tier Cap |
| -------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ------------------------ |
| Strength       | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 3                   |
| Dexterity      | +1          | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Agility        | +1          | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Constitution   | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Endurance      | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Intelligence   | -1          | 4d6        | Tier 3                   |
| Wisdom         | +2          | 4d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Charisma       | -4          | 4d6        | Tier 1                   |
| Luck           | 0           | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |

---

## Racial Traits
### Amphibious Nature
Uniden can breathe both air and water, easily adapting between land and aquatic environments.

### Waterborne Healing
When immersed in a natural source of water (like rivers or rain), Undines are able to regenerate health quicker:
- In combat: +3 HP per round  
- Out of combat: +10 HP per round 

---
### Drowned Soul
#### Description
The sea carries countless memories of those it has claimed. Drownedborn Undien possess an innate connection to these lingering echoes.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Gain +2 on Spirit-related checks.
- Can sense locations where death by drowning has occurred.
- Gain advantage when interacting with water-bound spirits.

---
### Echoes of the Lost
#### Description
Water remembers. By touching natural bodies of water, a Drownedborn may perceive fragments of memories carried within the current.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Gain advantage when investigating shipwrecks, submerged ruins, and missing persons cases.
- The GM may provide visions, emotions, sounds, or symbolic clues tied to events that occurred in nearby waters.
- Receive a +2 bonus to Investigation checks involving aquatic mysteries.

---

### Call of the Depths

#### Description
The ocean whispers warnings and secrets to its children.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Gain +2 Perception while within 30 metres of a natural body of water.
- Detect hidden submerged objects within 9 metres.
- Gain advantage when searching for underwater structures, shipwrecks, or hidden passages.

---

## Lore
Information coming soon.

## Culture
Information coming soon.

## Historical Figures
Information coming soon.

## Settlements
Information coming soon.

## Relations
Information coming soon.

## Traits & Biology
- Ignore difficult terrain while underwater.
- Can float motionless on water without effort.
- No movement penalties in deep water.

---

### ✅ Bonuses
- Enhanced Spirit Affinity
- Superior Underwater Mobility
- Excellent Investigators
- Strong Wisdom Bonuses
- Natural Connection to Ghosts and Spirits

### ⚠️ Drawbacks
- Sensitive to Spirit Corruption
- Frequently attract wandering spirits
- Emotional vulnerability to grief-based magic
- Unsettling presence may cause distrust among superstitious communities

---

# Earth Pixie

## Overview
# Pixie Lore

Pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **Avalon’s will and magic**. They are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

Though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## Origins of the Pixie

Pixies first emerged during the **Early Bloom of Avalon**, when the Fae Realm stabilised after its initial formation. Unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

Pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
They were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

From their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

Each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **Sprite**. Together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## The Split Soul Doctrine

Pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- Pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- Sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

Ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. A whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. A split soul remains adaptable.

This belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## The Worldroot Gate (Tree Portal)

Pixies do not freely cross between realms.

Instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **Worldroot Gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **Avalon** and **Asteria**.

### Key Facts
- The gate opens **once every 50 years**
- It remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- Only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- Mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

To pixies, this event is known as **The Crossing Bloom**.

---

## The Crossing Bloom

The Crossing Bloom is a time of:
- Celebration
- Mourning
- Oaths
- Long journeys

Pixies born in Avalon may choose to:
- Visit Asteria
- Remain behind permanently
- Escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- Observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

Pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

Those who miss the Crossing Bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## Pixies in Asterian History

Pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

They prefer to act as:
- Whispered guides
- Unseen helpers
- Saboteurs of great evils
- Inspirers of invention and art

Many pivotal moments in Asterian history coincide with **Crossing Bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## Notable Pixie Figures

### ✦ Queen Lythiriel of the Shimmergrove
The only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

Lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the Worldroot Gate was damaged by planar instability. Her reign lasted only one Crossing Bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into Avalon’s upper canopies.

Pixies still swear rare oaths **“by Lythiriel’s Leaves.”**

---

### ✦ King Bramblethorn (The Unwilling King)
A title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

Bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the Worldroot Gate during a Crossing Bloom. Though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across Asteria.

Some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ Nyx-of-the-Falling-Ash
A pixie hero bound to fire.

Nyx is credited with:
- Diverting a volcanic eruption
- Burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- Teaching early fire-mages restraint

Nyx never returned to Avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## Pixie Artisans & Crafters

Pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ The Glimmerhands
A collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- Ever-burning lanterns
- Floating instruments
- Soul-safe crystal foci

Each item crafted by a Glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ Thistlewick the Binder
An eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

Thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by Asterian artificers today. Many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## Pixies & Mortals

Pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

They admire:
- Creativity
- Defiance
- Emotional depth

They fear:
- Obsession
- Exploitation of magic
- Attempts to control the Worldroot Gate

Pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## Modern Pixie Beliefs

In the current age, pixies believe:
- The realms are drifting further apart
- Crossing Blooms feel more dangerous
- Magic in Asteria is becoming volatile

Some whisper that the Worldroot Gate may **one day fail entirely**.

If that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- Remain forever in Avalon  
- Or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## Final Words of Pixie Lore

> *“We are not small because we are weak.  We are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — Old Pixie Proverb

## 🧠 Notes

- Native to **Avalon (Fae Realm)**  
- Do not form structured societies  

Common habitats:
- Elemental groves  
- Floating crystal formations  
- Hidden fae sanctuaries  

Values:
- Freedom  
- Expression  
- Balance with nature  
- Soul connection

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - 15 cm to 60 cm  

- Weight Range:
  - 2 kg to 6 kg  

- Wings:
  - Insect-like, semi-translucent magical wings  
  - Shape varies depending on elemental affinity  

- Skin:
  - Soft, glowing, slightly translucent  
  - Colour Range:
    - Pastel → vibrant → elemental hues  

- Hair:
  - Light, flowing as if weightless  
  - Colour Range:
    - White → silver → elemental tones  

- Eyes:
  - Bright and glowing with elemental energy  
  - Colour Range:
    - Matches elemental affinity  

- Hands:
  - Tiny, delicate fingers  
  - Highly precise control for fine manipulation  

- Face:
  - Soft, expressive features  
  - Emotions often visible through subtle glow changes  

- Ears:
  - Small and pointed  

- Markings:
  - Faint glowing patterns tied to elemental nature  

- Body:
  - Extremely lightweight  
  - Movements are erratic, fluttering, and quick  

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristic Tier Cap |
| -------------- | :---------: | :--------: | :---------------------: |
| Strength       |     -3      |    2d4     |         Tier 1          |
| Dexterity      |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Agility        |     +2      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Constitution   |     -2      |    2d4     |         Tier 3          |
| Endurance      |      0      |    2d4     |         Tier 3          |
| Intelligence   |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Wisdom         |      0      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Charisma       |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Luck           |      0      |    3d6     |         Tier 5          |

---

## Racial Traits
### Magical Affinity (Innate)
- Born with **100 Affinity** in one elemental type  
- Cannot be changed or reduced  
- Reduced backlash from aligned magic  

### Racial Bond – Split Soul
Pixies are born with **half a soul**.

- The other half manifests as a **Sprite**
- Pixie and Sprite can sense one another across great distances
- When within close proximity, magic flows more smoothly

If the bond is damaged or severed, the Pixie and/or Sprite becomes **Unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences.

### Elemental Embodiment
- Emotions influence environment slightly  
- Enhances nearby aligned magic  
- Discomfort when exposed to opposing elements  

### Fae Perception
- Detect:
  - Illusions  
  - Glamours  
  - Magical distortions  
- Strong intuition for hidden intent  
- Struggles with rigid systems or logic  

---

| endurance      |      0      |    2d4     |         tier 3          |
| intelligence   |     +1      |    4d6     |         tier 5          |
| wisdom         |      0      |    4d6     |         tier 5          |
| charisma       |     +1      |    4d6     |         tier 5          |
| luck           |      0      |    3d6     |         tier 5          |

---

## racial traits
### magical affinity (innate)
- born with **100 affinity** in one elemental type  
- cannot be changed or reduced  
- reduced backlash from aligned magic  

### racial bond – split soul
pixies are born with **half a soul**.

- the other half manifests as a **sprite**
- pixie and sprite can sense one another across great distances
- when within close proximity, magic flows more smoothly

if the bond is damaged or severed, the pixie and/or sprite becomes **unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences.

### elemental embodiment
- emotions influence environment slightly  
- enhances nearby aligned magic  
- discomfort when exposed to opposing elements  

### fae perception
- detect:
  - illusions  
  - glamours  
  - magical distortions  
- strong intuition for hidden intent  
- struggles with rigid systems or logic  

---

## lore
# pixie lore

pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **avalon’s will and magic**. they are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## origins of the pixie

pixies first emerged during the **early bloom of avalon**, when the fae realm stabilised after its initial formation. unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
they were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

from their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **sprite**. together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## the split soul doctrine

pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. a whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. a split soul remains adaptable.

this belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## the worldroot gate (tree portal)

pixies do not freely cross between realms.

instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **worldroot gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **avalon** and **asteria**.

### key facts
- the gate opens **once every 50 years**
- it remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

to pixies, this event is known as **the crossing bloom**.

---

## the crossing bloom

the crossing bloom is a time of:
- celebration
- mourning
- oaths
- long journeys

pixies born in avalon may choose to:
- visit asteria
- remain behind permanently
- escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

those who miss the crossing bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## pixies in asterian history

pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

they prefer to act as:
- whispered guides
- unseen helpers
- saboteurs of great evils
- inspirers of invention and art

many pivotal moments in asterian history coincide with **crossing bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## notable pixie figures

### ✦ queen lythiriel of the shimmergrove
the only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the worldroot gate was damaged by planar instability. her reign lasted only one crossing bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into avalon’s upper canopies.

pixies still swear rare oaths **“by lythiriel’s leaves.”**

---

### ✦ king bramblethorn (the unwilling king)
a title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the worldroot gate during a crossing bloom. though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across asteria.

some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ nyx-of-the-falling-ash
a pixie hero bound to fire.

nyx is credited with:
- diverting a volcanic eruption
- burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- teaching early fire-mages restraint

nyx never returned to avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## pixie artisans & crafters

pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ the glimmerhands
a collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- ever-burning lanterns
- floating instruments
- soul-safe crystal foci

each item crafted by a glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ thistlewick the binder
an eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by asterian artificers today. many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## pixies & mortals

pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

they admire:
- creativity
- defiance
- emotional depth

they fear:
- obsession
- exploitation of magic
- attempts to control the worldroot gate

pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## modern pixie beliefs

in the current age, pixies believe:
- the realms are drifting further apart
- crossing blooms feel more dangerous
- magic in asteria is becoming volatile

some whisper that the worldroot gate may **one day fail entirely**.

if that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- remain forever in avalon  
- or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## final words of pixie lore

> *“we are not small because we are weak.  we are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — old pixie proverb

## 🧠 notes

- native to **avalon (fae realm)**  
- do not form structured societies  

common habitats:
- elemental groves  
- floating crystal formations  
- hidden fae sanctuaries  

values:
- freedom  
- expression  
- balance with nature  
- soul connection

# Fire Pixie

## Overview
# Pixie Lore

Pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **Avalon’s will and magic**. They are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

Though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## Origins of the Pixie

Pixies first emerged during the **Early Bloom of Avalon**, when the Fae Realm stabilised after its initial formation. Unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

Pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
They were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

From their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

Each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **Sprite**. Together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## The Split Soul Doctrine

Pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- Pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- Sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

Ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. A whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. A split soul remains adaptable.

This belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## The Worldroot Gate (Tree Portal)

Pixies do not freely cross between realms.

Instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **Worldroot Gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **Avalon** and **Asteria**.

### Key Facts
- The gate opens **once every 50 years**
- It remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- Only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- Mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

To pixies, this event is known as **The Crossing Bloom**.

---

## The Crossing Bloom

The Crossing Bloom is a time of:
- Celebration
- Mourning
- Oaths
- Long journeys

Pixies born in Avalon may choose to:
- Visit Asteria
- Remain behind permanently
- Escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- Observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

Pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

Those who miss the Crossing Bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## Pixies in Asterian History

Pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

They prefer to act as:
- Whispered guides
- Unseen helpers
- Saboteurs of great evils
- Inspirers of invention and art

Many pivotal moments in Asterian history coincide with **Crossing Bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## Notable Pixie Figures

### ✦ Queen Lythiriel of the Shimmergrove
The only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

Lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the Worldroot Gate was damaged by planar instability. Her reign lasted only one Crossing Bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into Avalon’s upper canopies.

Pixies still swear rare oaths **“by Lythiriel’s Leaves.”**

---

### ✦ King Bramblethorn (The Unwilling King)
A title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

Bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the Worldroot Gate during a Crossing Bloom. Though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across Asteria.

Some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ Nyx-of-the-Falling-Ash
A pixie hero bound to fire.

Nyx is credited with:
- Diverting a volcanic eruption
- Burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- Teaching early fire-mages restraint

Nyx never returned to Avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## Pixie Artisans & Crafters

Pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ The Glimmerhands
A collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- Ever-burning lanterns
- Floating instruments
- Soul-safe crystal foci

Each item crafted by a Glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ Thistlewick the Binder
An eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

Thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by Asterian artificers today. Many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## Pixies & Mortals

Pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

They admire:
- Creativity
- Defiance
- Emotional depth

They fear:
- Obsession
- Exploitation of magic
- Attempts to control the Worldroot Gate

Pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## Modern Pixie Beliefs

In the current age, pixies believe:
- The realms are drifting further apart
- Crossing Blooms feel more dangerous
- Magic in Asteria is becoming volatile

Some whisper that the Worldroot Gate may **one day fail entirely**.

If that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- Remain forever in Avalon  
- Or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## Final Words of Pixie Lore

> *“We are not small because we are weak.  We are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — Old Pixie Proverb

## 🧠 Notes

- Native to **Avalon (Fae Realm)**  
- Do not form structured societies  

Common habitats:
- Elemental groves  
- Floating crystal formations  
- Hidden fae sanctuaries  

Values:
- Freedom  
- Expression  
- Balance with nature  
- Soul connection

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - 15 cm to 60 cm  

- Weight Range:
  - 2 kg to 6 kg  

- Wings:
  - Insect-like, semi-translucent magical wings  
  - Shape varies depending on elemental affinity  

- Skin:
  - Soft, glowing, slightly translucent  
  - Colour Range:
    - Pastel → vibrant → elemental hues  

- Hair:
  - Light, flowing as if weightless  
  - Colour Range:
    - White → silver → elemental tones  

- Eyes:
  - Bright and glowing with elemental energy  
  - Colour Range:
    - Matches elemental affinity  

- Hands:
  - Tiny, delicate fingers  
  - Highly precise control for fine manipulation  

- Face:
  - Soft, expressive features  
  - Emotions often visible through subtle glow changes  

- Ears:
  - Small and pointed  

- Markings:
  - Faint glowing patterns tied to elemental nature  

- Body:
  - Extremely lightweight  
  - Movements are erratic, fluttering, and quick  

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristic Tier Cap |
| -------------- | :---------: | :--------: | :---------------------: |
| Strength       |     -3      |    2d4     |         Tier 1          |
| Dexterity      |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Agility        |     +2      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Constitution   |     -2      |    2d4     |         Tier 3          |
| Endurance      |      0      |    2d4     |         Tier 3          |
| Intelligence   |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Wisdom         |      0      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Charisma       |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Luck           |      0      |    3d6     |         Tier 5          |

---

## Racial Traits
### Magical Affinity (Innate)
- Born with **100 Affinity** in one elemental type  
- Cannot be changed or reduced  
- Reduced backlash from aligned magic  

### Racial Bond – Split Soul
Pixies are born with **half a soul**.

- The other half manifests as a **Sprite**
- Pixie and Sprite can sense one another across great distances
- When within close proximity, magic flows more smoothly

If the bond is damaged or severed, the Pixie and/or Sprite becomes **Unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences.

### Elemental Embodiment
- Emotions influence environment slightly  
- Enhances nearby aligned magic  
- Discomfort when exposed to opposing elements  

### Fae Perception
- Detect:
  - Illusions  
  - Glamours  
  - Magical distortions  
- Strong intuition for hidden intent  
- Struggles with rigid systems or logic  

---

# pixie lore

pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **avalon’s will and magic**. they are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## origins of the pixie

pixies first emerged during the **early bloom of avalon**, when the fae realm stabilised after its initial formation. unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
they were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

from their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **sprite**. together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## the split soul doctrine

pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. a whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. a split soul remains adaptable.

this belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## the worldroot gate (tree portal)

pixies do not freely cross between realms.

instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **worldroot gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **avalon** and **asteria**.

### key facts
- the gate opens **once every 50 years**
- it remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

to pixies, this event is known as **the crossing bloom**.

---

## the crossing bloom

the crossing bloom is a time of:
- celebration
- mourning
- oaths
- long journeys

pixies born in avalon may choose to:
- visit asteria
- remain behind permanently
- escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

those who miss the crossing bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## pixies in asterian history

pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

they prefer to act as:
- whispered guides
- unseen helpers
- saboteurs of great evils
- inspirers of invention and art

many pivotal moments in asterian history coincide with **crossing bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## notable pixie figures

### ✦ queen lythiriel of the shimmergrove
the only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the worldroot gate was damaged by planar instability. her reign lasted only one crossing bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into avalon’s upper canopies.

pixies still swear rare oaths **“by lythiriel’s leaves.”**

---

### ✦ king bramblethorn (the unwilling king)
a title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the worldroot gate during a crossing bloom. though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across asteria.

some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ nyx-of-the-falling-ash
a pixie hero bound to fire.

nyx is credited with:
- diverting a volcanic eruption
- burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- teaching early fire-mages restraint

nyx never returned to avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## pixie artisans & crafters

pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ the glimmerhands
a collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- ever-burning lanterns
- floating instruments
- soul-safe crystal foci

each item crafted by a glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ thistlewick the binder
an eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by asterian artificers today. many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## pixies & mortals

pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

they admire:
- creativity
- defiance
- emotional depth

they fear:
- obsession
- exploitation of magic
- attempts to control the worldroot gate

pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## modern pixie beliefs

in the current age, pixies believe:
- the realms are drifting further apart
- crossing blooms feel more dangerous
- magic in asteria is becoming volatile

some whisper that the worldroot gate may **one day fail entirely**.

if that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- remain forever in avalon  
- or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## final words of pixie lore

> *“we are not small because we are weak.  we are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — old pixie proverb

## 🧠 notes

- native to **avalon (fae realm)**  
- do not form structured societies  

common habitats:
- elemental groves  
- floating crystal formations  
- hidden fae sanctuaries  

values:
- freedom  
- expression  
- balance with nature  
- soul connection

- highly agile, erratic movement pattern  
- can hover and change direction instantly

---

### ⚠️ drawbacks
- very fragile (low hp potential)

- reliant on magic and positioning  
- vulnerable if grounded or restrained

— lirael, emberwing pixie

# Flowborn Undien

## Overview
- Race Category: Demi-Race
- Race Type: Spiritborn Humanoid
- Parent Race: River Spirit × Humanoid
- Playable: Yes
- Rarity: Uncommon

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - Male: 165cm - 190cm
  - Female: 155cm - 180cm

- Weight Range:
  - 55kg - 95kg

- Skin:
  - Smooth and healthy appearance
  - Warm to the touch
  - Colour Range:
    - Light Blue
    - River Green
    - Pale Teal
    - Soft Silver
    - Natural Human Tones with aquatic hues

- Hair:
  - Flows naturally even in still air
  - Colour Range:
    - Brown
    - Black
    - Blue
    - Green
    - Silver

- Eyes:
  - Bright and vibrant
  - Colour Range:
    - Emerald
    - Teal
    - Blue
    - Silver
    - Gold

- Hands:
  - Long graceful fingers
  - Slight webbing

- Face:
  - Gentle and welcoming features
  - Soft expressions

- Ears:
  - Slightly elongated
  - Smooth fin-like ridges

- Markings:
  - Flowing river-like patterns
  - Often glow softly when healing magic is used

- Body:
  - Lean and athletic
  - Built for endurance and movement
  - Naturally graceful posture

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristics Tier Cap |
| -------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ------------------------ |
| Strength       | -2          | 4d6        | Tier 3                   |
| Dexterity      | +1          | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Agility        | +2          | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Constitution   | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Endurance      | +1          | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Intelligence   | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Wisdom         | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Charisma       | +1          | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Luck           | 0           | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |

---

## Racial Traits
### Flow Sense

#### Description
Flowborn can instinctively feel the movement of water around them. Rivers, streams, rainfall, and currents act as extensions of their awareness.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Gain +2 Perception while within 30 metres of flowing water.
- Can determine the direction of nearby water sources.
- Gain advantage on Survival checks involving rivers, streams, and wetlands.
- Cannot become naturally lost while following a waterway.

---

### Spirit of Renewal

#### Description
Flowborn embody the restorative nature of rivers and freshwater springs.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Healing effects received are increased by 10%.
- Recover Stamina 25% faster during short rests.
- Gain +1 to all healing magic rolls.
- Natural healing is doubled while resting near fresh water.

---

### River Walker

#### Description
The currents support the Flowborn wherever they travel.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Ignore movement penalties caused by shallow water, mud, marshes, and wetlands.
- Gain advantage on Balance checks.
- Swim speed equals double normal movement speed.
- Can move across flowing water surfaces for up to 3 seconds before sinking.

---

### Breath of the Current

#### Description
Flowborn are equally comfortable above and below the water's surface.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Can breathe underwater indefinitely.
- Ignore underwater combat penalties.
- Gain resistance to exhaustion caused by swimming.
- Never suffer penalties from strong river currents.

---

## Traits & Biology
- Swim Speed: 18m
- Ignore difficult terrain caused by rivers, marshes, wetlands, and shallow water.
- Gain +3m movement speed while travelling alongside natural waterways.
- Can swim continuously without fatigue for extended periods.

---

### ✅ Bonuses
- Enhanced Healing
- Excellent Endurance
- Strong Survival Skills
- Superior River Navigation
- Natural Adaptability

### ⚠️ Drawbacks
- Less effective in deserts and arid climates.
- Reduced comfort in saltwater environments.
- Strong emotional connection to nature can make environmental destruction distressing.

---
